title: Mobile Application Developer – Flutter
company: NG GLOBAL (IT) SERVICES INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED
description:
**Company:** IH\&MS Infra India Pvt. Ltd.  
**Location:** Office No. 304, Nyati Millennium, Opposite Panchashil Business Tower, Near Datta Mandir Chowk, Viman Nagar, Pune, Maharashtra – 411014  
**Job Type:** Full\-Time  
**Experience:** 1\.5\+ Years  
**Salary:** ₹20,000\+ per month, based on experience and skills  
**Preference: Immediate Joiners**

**Candidates currently based in Pune will be preferred due to urgent hiring.**

**Job Summary**

We are looking for a skilled Mobile Application Developer with strong hands\-on experience in Flutter and Dart. The candidate should be capable of developing mobile applications from scratch to deployment for both Android and iOS platforms.

The ideal candidate should have experience in complete mobile application development, including UI implementation, API integration, database integration, testing, debugging, build generation, and publishing applications to the Google Play Store and Apple App Store.

**Key Skills**

* Flutter \& Dart
* Android \& iOS Application Development
* REST API Integration
* JSON \& HTTP
* Firebase
* State Management – Provider / Bloc / GetX / Riverpod
* SQLite / MySQL / Firebase Database
* Git \& GitHub
* Responsive UI Development
* Push Notifications
* Authentication \& Authorization
* Payment Gateway Integration
* Debugging \& Performance Optimization
* Android Studio / VS Code
* Xcode
* App Build \& Release Management

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Develop mobile applications using Flutter and Dart for Android and iOS.**
* Build applications from scratch, starting from requirements and UI implementation through final deployment.
* Create responsive and user\-friendly mobile interfaces.
* Integrate REST APIs, third\-party services, Firebase, and other backend services.
* Implement authentication, notifications, database connectivity, and other required mobile features.
* Perform testing, debugging, troubleshooting, and performance optimization.
* Generate Android APK/AAB and iOS builds for release.
* Manage app signing, certificates, provisioning profiles, and release configurations.
* Publish and maintain applications on the Google Play Store and Apple App Store.
* Collaborate with backend developers, UI/UX designers, and other team members.
* Maintain clean, reusable, and scalable code.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, or a related field.
* 1\.5\+ years of hands\-on experience in Flutter/Dart development.
* Strong understanding of mobile application development lifecycle.
* **Must have experience developing and deploying applications on both Android and iOS.**
* Should be capable of independently taking an application from development to production deployment.
* Good problem\-solving and debugging skills.
* Good communication and teamwork skills.
* Must have own laptop.
* Candidates currently based in Pune will be preferred.
* Immediate joiners or candidates who can join at short notice are preferred.

**Good to Have**

* Knowledge of native Android/iOS development is an advantage.
* Experience maintaining and publishing live applications on Play Store and App Store.

Pay: From ₹20,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Mobile Application Developer
description:
**Position:** Mobile Application Developer  

**Experience:** 5\+ years  

**Location:** Pune  

**Shift Time:** 12:00PM \- 9:00PM IST  

  

**Job Description:**  

We are looking for a modern mobile engineer who can work confidently across React Native, Expo, TypeScript, enterprise CI/CD, mobile distribution, and production support. The ideal candidate uses AI tools intelligently to accelerate delivery, but still demonstrates strong fundamentals, ownership, security awareness, and accountability for the software they ship.  

  

**Responsibilities:**


* Build, enhance, and maintain mobile application features across iOS and Android using React Native, Expo, TypeScript, JavaScript, and React fundamentals.
* Translate business requirements, wireframes, Figma designs, and design\-system guidance into polished, accessible, and maintainable mobile user interfaces.
* Work effectively within mobile monorepos, shared packages, dependency management models, and workspace tooling.
* Support Azure DevOps CI/CD using YAML pipelines, secure files and secrets, automated builds, automated testing, codesigning, and release approvals.
* Integrate mobile applications with RESTful APIs, authentication flows, secure storage, and enterprise backend services.
* Contribute to automated testing, TDD/BDD practices, mobile quality gates, code review, and defect prevention.
* Work within Agile/Scrum delivery practices, contributing to sprint planning, backlog refinement, reviews, retrospectives, and transparent progress tracking in Azure DevOps.
* Collaborate effectively with product, design, QA, backend, platform, architecture, and operations stakeholders.

**Required Skills:**
* Strong React Native, Expo ecosystem, and TypeScript experience.
* Strong JavaScript and React fundamentals, including modern state management and navigation patterns.
* Experience building and maintaining iOS and Android apps in enterprise environments.
* Strong understanding of monorepos, shared packages, dependency management, and mobile workspace tooling.
* Experience with Azure DevOps CI/CD, including YAML pipelines, secure files/secrets, automated builds, testing, signing, and release approvals.
* Practical experience building, signing, distributing, and supporting mobile apps through App Store Connect, TestFlight, Google Play Console, and internal distribution channels.
* Experience integrating with RESTful APIs, authentication flows, secure storage, and enterprise backend services.
* Good understanding of mobile security, performance, accessibility, observability, and production support.
* Experience with automated testing, TDD/BDD practices, and mobile quality gates.
* Ability to implement polished UI from Figma, wireframes, and design systems.
* Strong Git, code review, Agile/Scrum, and engineering delivery discipline.
* Comfortable using AI\-assisted development tools such as Codex, Cursor, Copilot, or ChatGPT to improve productivity while maintaining accountability, code quality, and sound engineering judgement.


**Company Profile**  

Stratacent is a Global IT Consulting and Services firm, headquartered in Jersey City, NJ, with global delivery centres in Pune and Gurugram plus offices in USA, London, Canada and South Africa. We are a leading IT services provider focusing on Financial Services, Insurance, Healthcare and Life Sciences. We help our customers in their transformation journey and provide services around Information Security, Cloud Services, Data and AI, Automation, Application Development and IT Operations.  

URL \- **http://stratacent.com**
